title: Sevitzky, the Indianapolis conductor, and the censored file
summary: Asked about Sevitzky, Mazzari hesitates and they agree the tape can be placed in a censored file.

story.theme_name: Starting the tape: names, dates and places
story.community_name: Interview openings: names, dates and tape setup

blocks.x: I thought I told you how to say that, didn't I? You did, but I wanted to get it down on tape so I could practice. Okay. Now let's see, Savitsky was in Indianapolis, huh?
Yes, he was. Old Fabian, we used to call him Beanie because he came from Boston. Dick? Mm-hmm. That's all I'm being.
Well, we don't want to put this tape on the censored file and nobody will hear it that way so...
Yeah, we can put it in a censored file.
